title: WorkerHealthStatus
description: Persisted periodic Control Plane mTLS observation for the current Lease generation/resource version. Database time determines online, unavailable, or expired. Absence means not observed; deployment ready is not online. Freshness lasts at most 60 seconds and never exceeds Lease expiry.
x-cloud-agents-semantic-constraints: checkedAt < expiresAt <= checkedAt + 60 seconds, capped by the current Lease expiry
lastSuccessAt, when present, is no later than checkedAt; online requires equal instants
state is a database-time snapshot, never inferred from the browser clock or deployment phase
